Abacavir: CI if + HLA-B*5701 allele because of ↑ risk of hypersensitivity rxn
: inhibits viral replication by interfering w/ HIV viral RNA-dependent DNA polymerase
: inhibits HIV protease leading to production of noninfectious, immature HIV particles
: prevents insertion of a DNA copy of the viral genome into the host DNA
: disrupts the virus from fusing w/ healthy T cells
